reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the big "200 mg" on the front, and then that it is two capsules in a sachet, which is exactly what I expected. I stick with Pure Encapsulations or Thorne with an NSF or USP seal, and a new brand with no reviews and only its own lab QR code does not replace that for something I take every day.
objection: No NSF or USP seal and no reviews. A QR code to a report the brand itself links to is not the same as a third party certifying the product. Also about $1 a day for two capsules is not cheap next to what I pay for my usual brand.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP seal on the box, or a few hundred verified reviews, plus a doctor-friendly label showing exactly how much magnesium I get per capsule.
